g.text: The ceiling is the best accuracy any deterministic model can reach against the majority vote of a

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #9aa0a6

g.text: 10-rater panel. It binds only if a paper scored against that consensus label. Eleven of the thirteen

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #9aa0a6

g.text: modelling papers checked state no label target at all, so the excess cannot be attributed either way.
